subject.title: fix(ui): show config path in overview snapshot (Fixes #53958)

question: Should OpenClaw surface the active config path in the Overview snapshot card, move the same information to Settings/Config, or keep config-path discovery out of the UI?
rationale: The technical change is narrow, but the linked feature request leaves placement open and the PR makes an absolute local path prominent in a user-facing page.

options.title: Accept Overview Row
options.body: Land this display-only approach after real running-Control-UI proof shows the existing admin-scoped snapshot field renders correctly.

options.title: Move To Settings Or Config
options.body: Ask for the same existing field to be shown in a less prominent settings/config information area instead of Overview.

options.title: Keep CLI Only
options.body: Decline UI exposure and rely on already merged CLI/config troubleshooting surfaces for path discovery.

recommendation.title: Accept Overview Row
recommendation.body: Land this display-only approach after real running-Control-UI proof shows the existing admin-scoped snapshot field renders correctly.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev has the strongest feature-history signal for the Overview presentation surface that would receive this visible row.
